# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # Looks for references of Regexp captures that are out of range
      # and thus always returns nil.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it is naive in how it determines what
      #   references are available based on the last encountered regexp, but
      #   it cannot handle some cases, such as conditional regexp matches, which
      #   leads to false positives, such as:
      #
      #   [source,ruby]
      #   ----
      #   foo ? /(c)(b)/ =~ str : /(b)/ =~ str
      #   do_something if $2
      #   # $2 is defined for the first condition but not the second, however
      #   # the cop will mark this as an offense.
      #   ----
      #
      #   This might be a good indication of code that should be refactored,
      #   however.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   /(foo)bar/ =~ 'foobar'
      #
      #   # bad - always returns nil
      #
      #   puts $2 # => nil
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   puts $1 # => foo
      #
      class OutOfRangeRegexpRef < Base
        MSG = '$%<backref>s is out of range (%<count>s regexp capture %<group>s detected).'

        REGEXP_RECEIVER_METHODS = %i[=~ === match].to_set.freeze
        REGEXP_ARGUMENT_METHODS = %i[=~ match grep gsub gsub! sub sub! [] slice slice! index rindex
                                     scan partition rpartition start_with? end_with?].to_set.freeze
        REGEXP_CAPTURE_METHODS = (REGEXP_RECEIVER_METHODS + REGEXP_ARGUMENT_METHODS).freeze
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = REGEXP_CAPTURE_METHODS

        def on_new_investigation
          @valid_ref = 0
        end

        def on_match_with_lvasgn(node)
          check_regexp(node.children.first)
        end

        def after_send(node)
          @valid_ref = nil
          if node
            method_name = node.method_name
            receiver = node.receiver
            first_argument = node.first_argument
            argument_nodes = node.arguments
            argument_count = argument_nodes.length
            argument_selectors = []
            if method_name == :=~
              argument_selectors << :=~
            elsif method_name == :match
              argument_selectors << :match
            elsif method_name == :grep
              argument_selectors << :grep
            elsif method_name == :gsub
              argument_selectors << :gsub
            elsif method_name == :gsub!
              argument_selectors << :gsub!
            elsif method_name == :sub
              argument_selectors << :sub
            elsif method_name == :sub!
              argument_selectors << :sub!
            elsif method_name == :[]
              argument_selectors << :[]
            elsif method_name == :slice
              argument_selectors << :slice
            elsif method_name == :slice!
              argument_selectors << :slice!
            elsif method_name == :index
              argument_selectors << :index
            elsif method_name == :rindex
              argument_selectors << :rindex
            elsif method_name == :scan
              argument_selectors << :scan
            elsif method_name == :partition
              argument_selectors << :partition
            elsif method_name == :rpartition
              argument_selectors << :rpartition
            elsif method_name == :start_with?
              argument_selectors << :start_with?
            elsif method_name == :end_with?
              argument_selectors << :end_with?
            elsif method_name == :===
              argument_selectors = []
            end

            regexp_node = nil
            argument_kind = nil
            if argument_selectors.length.positive?
              if argument_count.positive?
                if first_argument
                  if first_argument.regexp_type?
                    regexp_node = first_argument
                    argument_kind = :regexp
                  elsif first_argument.str_type?
                    argument_kind = :str
                  elsif first_argument.dstr_type?
                    argument_kind = :dstr
                  elsif first_argument.send_type?
                    argument_kind = :send
                  elsif first_argument.csend_type?
                    argument_kind = :csend
                  elsif first_argument.lvar_type?
                    argument_kind = :lvar
                  elsif first_argument.ivar_type?
                    argument_kind = :ivar
                  elsif first_argument.gvar_type?
                    argument_kind = :gvar
                  elsif first_argument.const_type?
                    argument_kind = :const
                  elsif first_argument.begin_type?
                    argument_kind = :begin
                  elsif first_argument.nth_ref_type?
                    argument_kind = :nth_ref
                  elsif first_argument.sym_type?
                    argument_kind = :sym
                  else
                    argument_kind = first_argument.type
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            receiver_kind = nil
            if regexp_node.nil?
              if receiver
                if receiver.regexp_type?
                  regexp_node = receiver
                  receiver_kind = :regexp
                elsif receiver.str_type?
                  receiver_kind = :str
                elsif receiver.dstr_type?
                  receiver_kind = :dstr
                elsif receiver.send_type?
                  receiver_kind = :send
                elsif receiver.lvar_type?
                  receiver_kind = :lvar
                elsif receiver.const_type?
                  receiver_kind = :const
                elsif receiver.nth_ref_type?
                  receiver_kind = :nth_ref
                else
                  receiver_kind = receiver.type
                end
              end
            end

            if regexp_node
              interpolated = false
              has_literal_content = false
              str_chunks = []
              begin_chunks = []
              option_flags = []
              children = regexp_node.children
              if children
                index = 0
                child_count = children.length
                while index < child_count
                  child = children[index]
                  if child
                    if child.begin_type?
                      interpolated = true
                      begin_chunks << child
                      inner = child.children
                      if inner
                        inner_index = 0
                        inner_count = inner.length
                        while inner_index < inner_count
                          inner_child = inner[inner_index]
                          begin_chunks << inner_child
                          interpolated = true
                          inner_index += 1
                        end
                      end
                    elsif child.str_type?
                      raw_chunk = child.str_content.to_s
                      source_chunk = child.source.to_s
                      interpreted_chunk = interpret_string_escapes(raw_chunk)
                      interpreted_source = interpret_string_escapes(source_chunk)
                      str_chunks << raw_chunk
                      str_chunks << source_chunk
                      str_chunks << interpreted_chunk
                      str_chunks << interpreted_source
                      chunk_length = raw_chunk.length
                      chunk_length += source_chunk.length
                      chunk_length += interpreted_chunk.length
                      chunk_length += interpreted_source.length
                      if chunk_length.positive?
                        has_literal_content = true
                      end
                    elsif child.dstr_type?
                      str_chunks << child.source.to_s
                      has_literal_content = true
                    elsif child.regopt_type?
                      option_children = child.children
                      if option_children
                        option_index = 0
                        option_count = option_children.length
                        while option_index < option_count
                          option_flags << option_children[option_index]
                          option_index += 1
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  index += 1
                end
              end

              joined_chunks = str_chunks.join
              interpreted_joined = interpret_string_escapes(joined_chunks)
              if interpreted_joined.length.positive?
                has_literal_content = true
              end
              if begin_chunks.length.positive?
                interpolated = true
              end
              if option_flags.length.positive?
                has_literal_content = true
              end
              if argument_kind == :regexp
                regexp_node = first_argument
              elsif receiver_kind == :regexp
                regexp_node = receiver
              end

              if interpolated
                @valid_ref = nil
              else
                named_count = 0
                numbered_count = 0
                tree = nil
                if has_literal_content
                  tree = regexp_node.located_parse_tree
                end
                if tree.nil?
                  @valid_ref = 0
                else
                  tree.traverse do |event, exp, _index|
                    entered = false
                    if event == :enter
                      entered = true
                    end
                    if entered
                      lookbehind = false
                      capturing = false
                      named_capture = false
                      token = nil
                      if exp
                        expression_text = exp.text.to_s
                        lookbehind = expression_text.start_with?('(?<=')
                        if exp.respond_to?(:capturing?)
                          capturing = exp.capturing?
                        end
                        named_capture = exp.respond_to?(:name)
                        token = exp.token
                      end
                      countable = false
                      if capturing
                        countable = true
                      end
                      if lookbehind
                        countable = false
                      end
                      if countable
                        if token == :named
                          named_count += 1
                        elsif token == :capture
                          if named_capture
                            named_count += 1
                          else
                            numbered_count += 1
                          end
                        elsif token == :passive
                          if named_capture
                            named_count += 1
                          else
                            numbered_count += 1
                          end
                        else
                          if named_capture
                            named_count += 1
                          else
                            numbered_count += 1
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                  if named_count.positive?
                    @valid_ref = named_count
                  else
                    @valid_ref = numbered_count
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def on_when(node)
          regexp_conditions = node.conditions.select(&:regexp_type?)

          @valid_ref = regexp_conditions.filter_map { |condition| check_regexp(condition) }.max
        end

        def on_in_pattern(node)
          regexp_patterns = regexp_patterns(node)

          @valid_ref = regexp_patterns.filter_map { |pattern| check_regexp(pattern) }.max
        end

        def on_nth_ref(node)
          backref = node.children.first
          return if @valid_ref.nil? || backref <= @valid_ref

          message = format(
            MSG,
            backref: backref,
            count: @valid_ref.zero? ? 'no' : @valid_ref,
            group: @valid_ref == 1 ? 'group' : 'groups'
          )

          add_offense(node, message: message)
        end

        private

        def regexp_patterns(in_node)
          pattern = in_node.pattern
          if pattern.regexp_type?
            [pattern]
          else
            pattern.each_descendant(:regexp).to_a
          end
        end

        def check_regexp(node)
          return if node.interpolation?

          named_capture = node.each_capture(named: true).count
          @valid_ref = if named_capture.positive?

        end

        end

        def offenses
          @offenses ||= offenses_per_cop.flatten(1)
        end

          InvestigationReport.new(processed_source,
                                  cop_reports + investigation.cop_reports,
                                  errors + investigation.errors)
        end
      end

        @forces = forces
        @options = options
        initialize_callbacks
